optimizedDescription.value: Global CLI contract: config discovery, output streams, formats, errors, exits, help, dashboard, and command registration.

optimizedContext.value:
# CLI Entrypoint

## Rules
- Discover `specd.yaml` CWD→git root; no config/unreadable explicit `--config` → exit 1 stderr. Root `--config` supports before/after command; `preAction` propagates root value; duplicate last wins.
- Normal output stdout; errors/warnings/diagnostics stderr. Exit: 0 success, 1 domain/user, 2 hook, 3 system; no others. Hook streams forwarded.
- `--format text|json|toon`, default `text`; JSON/TOON same model stdout. Errors stay plain stderr; JSON/TOON also structured stdout. Typed `SpecdCliError extends SpecdError`; no bare `Error` in user-facing paths.
- Format commands add `\nJSON/TOON output schema:` help block, TS shape, optional `?`, inline arrays. All leaf commands `.allowExcessArguments(false)`.
- Root help only: ASCII banner plus versions `@specd/cli`, `@specd/sdk`, `CORE_VERSION`, `codeGraphVersion`. Bare `specd`/`specd --config` dispatches `project dashboard` if config exists, else help. `specd init` equals `specd project init`.
- `createProgram(): Command` separates registrations from execution. `renderTable`/`fitColumnsToTerminal` shrink right→left, min 10, wrap/truncate; non-TTY natural width.
- Register lazy top-level `guide-sdk`, backed by `@specd/guide/sdk`; standard config, output, errors, formats, schema-help, positional rules; existing commands unchanged.
- `@specd/cli` and `@specd/mcp` depend directly only on `@specd/sdk` among platform packages.

## Constraints
- Config discovery never crosses git root.
- Stdout/stderr independent; exit 2 only hooks.
- Banner root `specd --help` only.
